Presenting a new Ganpati Songs as this is that time of the year when Ganesh Chaturthi fervor is in the air, We bring to you song titled "Ganesha", Sung by Jubin Nautiyal. The music for this Ganpati Songs is by Raaj Aashoo & Lyrics are by Murali Agarwal. The video features Arjan Bajwa & Hritiqa Chheber.
